groups.saying_opens: إن المؤمن إذا مات لم يكن ميتا

notes: Two sayings. The first, al-Hasan's answer on death, has no written transmitter (the asker is passive: «وسئل»), so the Imam alone is the route (rule 10).

The second has Saduq's own chain «حدثني أبي، عن أبيه، عن جده، عن الصادق» with three relations and al-Sadiq as the last link. The Quranic verse and the explanatory «يعني» are the text's own words, not links.
